title: NO CONTROLS LIST OVER THE ITEM WHEEL
why: UI critic, screen 61: the controls list was drawn over the item wheel. The backpack already steps the list aside; the wheel now does too.
now: The controls list hides while the item wheel is open.

edits.replacement: if(G&&(G.bagOpen||G.wheel)&&!G.over) return;   // v32.xx (cw-wheelnolegend): the critic saw the controls list drawn over the item wheel (screen 61); like the backpack, the wheel steps the list aside
